scientific_integrity: Novel contribution is confined to the F4 remaining cases and the trace-kernel factorization obstruction. Previously published classifications and F2 counterexamples are attributed.
scientific_limitations: Uses the existing reduction of unresolved F4 degree-two RDP del Pezzo types to A2 and A4 and the separability criterion of Uppal. Small exact F2-matrix rank is certified by embedded standalone Python. Geometric integrality is required; F2 admits counterexamples; no unirationality or independent validation asserted.
title: Smooth rational points on degree-two singular del Pezzo surfaces over \(\mathbf F_4\)
